name: numaco
description: Numaco AG's public Claude Code plugins

plugins.name: numaco-design
plugins.description: Numaco branded output engine: renders slide decks, statements of work, reports, and timesheets from markdown to branded PDF.

plugins.name: review-kit
plugins.description: Markdown review trio (green-mark co-authoring, release QA) plus a dual-vault-sync engine for laptop and mobile Obsidian.

plugins.name: mcp-mail
plugins.description: Self-hosted MCP server giving Claude read and write control over your own mail, calendar, and files across Microsoft 365 (including SharePoint and OneDrive), Google Workspace (Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides, Calendar), IMAP, and a local iCloud or OneDrive folder. 55 tools; calendar and files are opt-in per account.

plugins.name: numaco-hub
plugins.description: Front door for the Numaco plugins: guided setup skill and an on-demand update command.

plugins.name: clockify-mcp
plugins.description: Clockify time tracking for Claude Code: files entries through a Numaco-hosted MCP server (your Clockify key is decrypted there per request, not kept in your keychain) and scans your calendar for un-logged meetings.
